limits: Scoped software preservation and reference-size patch statistics only. Whole-interface 1:1 remains unmet and unwaived. Full-frame visual admission, ordinary native glyph/contrast, clip companion/repeat checks, actual application captures, real display/DPI/input, accessibility and physical/audio fidelity require separate source-bound evidence. Maximum-geometry resource cases expose only 64x64 output and therefore have no protected output pixels.

identities.source_binding_limit: Source, protocol and executable hashes plus the retained genuine supplemental before build receipt; hashes alone do not prove coherent candidate compilation. Root retains actual coordinated build evidence.
